title: Pre-Analysis — Main Gear Side Stay Lock Link Overcentre Rework on the Stretched Four-Engine Aircraft

ata.title: Main Gear — Side Stay and Lock Links

abstract: Original pre-analysis for the lock link overcentre rework on the wing-mounted main gear of the stretched four-engine aircraft. The scope as framed was rejected because the unsafe indication cannot be separated from the sensing.

sections.objective: Assess the proposed rework of the lock link actuation on the wing-mounted main gear, scoped at the time as a mechanical change to the overcentre geometry alone, against the unsafe gear indication reports collected over two cold seasons. The work order had to confirm that a geometry change would remove the reported condition, and to identify anything else in the gear bay that the rework would disturb during embodiment.
sections.findings_summary: The scope does not match the evidence. Roughly half of the reported events show a healthy overcentre travel with a proximity target that never came into range, which is a sensing condition and not a geometry condition; the bay wiring sheet places both downlock targets and their harness in the three zones the rework moves hardware through, and any geometry change displaces them. A rework that touches the link and leaves the sensing untouched would therefore fix part of the fleet and disturb the rest. The embodiment side produced one further item: the green system engine driven pump is removed through the same bay and its task requires the system depressurised, which is the same condition the lock link work needs, so the two compete for one aircraft slot. Nothing was found that argues against the geometry change itself.
sections.next_steps: Reject the scope as framed and re-raise it to cover the downlock proximity sensing together with the link actuation, with the bay wiring office named in the scope from the start. Ask the reporting operators to split their events into travel and sensing categories so the re-scoped work has a defensible population. Note the shared bay access with the hydraulic pump work in whatever retrofit vehicle follows, so that operators plan a single gear bay entry.

tasks.title: Classify the reported events into travel and sensing categories
Locate the downlock targets and harness against the moved hardware
Identify other bay work sharing the embodiment access

expected_findings.rationale: Both downlock proximity targets and their harness sit in the three zones the rework moves hardware through. Half the reported events are sensing events rather than travel events, so a geometry-only scope leaves the reported condition partly unaddressed and displaces the sensing it depends on.
expected_findings.resolution: Re-scope the work to cover the sensing together with the link actuation, with the wiring office named from the start.

expected_findings.rationale: The engine driven pump is installed through the same gear bay and its task requires the green system depressurised, which is also the condition for lock link work. The two documents share no vocabulary; only the bay zone connects them.
expected_findings.resolution: Note the shared access in whatever retrofit vehicle follows the re-scoped design.

evidence.similarity_note: Similarity only. Both texts describe a margin set at certification and eroded by the heavier stretched airframe, one in wing structure language and one in landing gear language. No identifier of any kind is shared.

expected_findings.rationale: The wing reinforcement records the same underlying story about the stretched aircraft's load path and the assumptions carried over from the shorter variant. Its substantiation approach is a useful precedent for the re-scoped work.
expected_findings.resolution: Reference the precedent in the re-scoped work order; no action against the wing modification.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares the gear bay zone with the installation task and is returned immediately beside it. Removal does not require the system depressurised in the same sense and imposes no constraint on lock link access, so the concurrency argument does not extend to it.

type_data.conclusion: Scope rejected as framed. The sensing cannot be separated from the actuation; the work is to be re-raised covering both, with the wiring office in scope.
